B130.en: Which ballot paper would be valid in a Bundestag election? Based on the Federal Electoral Regulations (BWO), Annex 26.

B232.en: Who is elected in the European elections?
B232.expDe: Bei der Europawahl werden die Abgeordneten des Europäischen Parlaments gewählt.
B232.expEn: In the European elections, the members of the European Parliament are elected.

B247.en: A woman is pregnant. She is specially protected by law shortly before and after the birth of her child. What is this protection called?
B247.expDe: Der besondere Schutz vor und nach der Geburt heißt Mutterschutz.
B247.expEn: The special protection before and after childbirth is called Mutterschutz (maternity protection).

B251.en: If someone hits a child in Germany, …

B255.en: In case of parenting problems, parents in Germany can get help from …
B255.expEn: In case of parenting problems, the Jugendamt (youth welfare office) provides help.

B265.en: Where must one go first in Germany if one wants to get married?
B265.expDe: Die Eheschließung wird beim Standesamt angemeldet.
B265.expEn: A marriage is registered at the Standesamt (civil registry office).

B267.en: A young woman in Germany, 22 years old, lives with her boyfriend. Her parents do not like this because they do not like the boyfriend. What can the parents do?
B267.expDe: Die Tochter ist volljährig; die Eltern müssen ihre Entscheidung respektieren.
B267.expEn: The daughter is an adult; the parents must respect her decision.

HB02.en: Which of these is a district (Stadtteil) of Bremen?
HB02.expDe: Hemelingen ist ein Stadtteil von Bremen; die anderen Optionen gehören zu anderen Städten bzw. Bundesländern.
HB02.expEn: Hemelingen is a district (Stadtteil) of Bremen; the other options belong to other cities or states.

HB07.expDe: Bremen ist neben Berlin und Hamburg einer der drei Stadtstaaten Deutschlands.
HB07.expEn: Bremen is one of Germany's three city-states, along with Berlin and Hamburg.

SN07.en: The state capital of Saxony is called …
SN07.expDe: Dresden ist die Landeshauptstadt von Sachsen.
SN07.expEn: Dresden is the state capital of Saxony.
